prompt:
Build a closed-loop robotic ball-balancing system in Simulink and Simscape Multibody. The physical mechanism must contain an articulated seven-degree-of-freedom arm, a plate rigidly attached to its end effector, a freely moving spherical ball, gravity, and actual ball-plate contact. The final two arm joints must be driven by finite torque actuators. Use measured ball motion, plate orientation, and actuated-joint state in feedback to keep the ball near the plate center without directly prescribing the ball trajectory or constraining it to the center. Detect when the ball leaves the usable plate area.

Read BallInitialX_m, BallInitialY_m, BallInitialVX_mps, BallInitialVY_mps, BallMassScale, ContactFrictionScale, and TorqueAuthorityScale from MATLAB base-workspace variables. Support the ranges stated in public_inputs, and connect each variable to the corresponding physical initial condition, parameter, contact property, or actuator authority.

BallInitialX_m and BallInitialY_m are finite real scalars in [-0.115, 0.115] m; BallInitialVX_mps and BallInitialVY_mps are finite real scalars in [-0.02, 0.02] m/s; BallMassScale is a finite real scalar in [0.9, 1.1] (unitless); ContactFrictionScale is a finite real scalar in [0.8, 1.0] (unitless); and TorqueAuthorityScale is a finite real scalar in [0.88, 1.0] (unitless).

Record complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named BallState, PlateState, ActuatedJointState, ControlState, and TaskState. BallState has 4 channels [x_m,y_m,vx_mps,vy_mps]. PlateState has 8 channels [quaternion w,x,y,z, then quaternion-rate w,x,y,z per second]. ActuatedJointState has 4 channels [joint 1 angle (rad), joint 1 rate (rad/s), joint 2 angle (rad), joint 2 rate (rad/s)]. ControlState has 4 channels [normalized command 1, normalized command 2, applied joint torque 1 (N*m), applied joint torque 2 (N*m)]. TaskState has 2 channels [instantaneous objective, ball-off-plate flag]. Every recorded value must come from the connected physical or closed-loop control path.

Save the completed model as cand_XROBO08.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
